d: Watch this video as Firstpost explains how a crackdown on illegal gold mining in Guinea has triggered a mass exodus, an RTB broadcast ban, and a diplomatic clash testing ties with Burkina Faso. After Guinea moved against artisanal mining in Siguiri, more than 76,000 people—including over 15,000 children—were repatriated to Burkina Faso by November 18, while displaced miners recount beatings, lost documents, and livelihoods wiped out as they returned empty-handed.
